description: The community consensus for one game on needmoar.games: how liked it is (the share of a typical library it beats), its tier and rank, the full distribution of opinions, and the games players who like it also like or dislike — useful for "how popular / well-liked is X?" and "games similar to X". Also, in the players' own words, what they liked about it and what kept them from ranking it higher (short tags with counts), once enough players said so. Pass a Steam appid — resolve names with search_games first. The response links to the game's page you can cite.

appid.description: Steam appid of the game (resolve names with search_games).

name: game_detail
title: How liked is a game
